selection.summary: Fix for #1241: in ZSTD_window_update (lib/compress/zstd_compress_internal.h, ~lines 656-715), when the window is used for the first time the base reference starts at index 0, making the first input position invalid for a match. The fix is to initialize the reference starting at 1 (window->base = (BYTE const*)src - 1 and correspondingly dictBase/dictLimit) so index 0 is never a valid match position. Handles h0/h8/h10 cover the ZSTD_window_update body and surrounding window-state code where the change belongs.
